domain_conditions: N is an integer and N >= 3

admissibility_conditions: all primitive restrictions in N3-CELL-COMPLETE-MAJORITY hold
for each recognized proposer i, F_i is a probability distribution supported on A_i_star(nu)
A_i_star applies proposer-payoff maximization first and the authorized minimum-expected-H tie-break second
ballot strategies are pure even when proposer strategies F_i are mixed
no symmetry restriction is imposed across proposer identities
equilibrium_records.branch_classification: complete ex-post majority correspondence over exclusion, low-type screening, pooling inclusion, and delay

definitions.K_of_s: {j in W without i: x_j >= w}

strategy_profile.weak_nonproposer_vote_after_every_feasib: yes iff x_j >= w; at x_j=w genuine indifference is resolved by T^Y in favor of yes

hegemon_vote_after_every_feasible_propos.if_k_at_least_q_minus_1: no for both types; yes pays y and no pays y+o_theta because the proposal passes without H
hegemon_vote_after_every_feasible_propos.if_k_equals_q_minus_2: type theta votes yes iff y >= t_theta; T^Y selects yes at y=t_theta
hegemon_vote_after_every_feasible_propos.if_k_at_most_q_minus_3: yes for both types by T^Y because either vote leads to N1 continuation payoff t_theta

proposer_payoff_for_every_feasible_propo.if_k_equals_q_minus_2: (1-nu)*[r_i if y>=t_0 else w]+nu*[r_i if y>=t_1 else w]

pure_candidate_families.E_i: choose any K subset of W without i with |K|=q-1; y=0; x_j=w on K and 0 otherwise; r_i=E
pure_candidate_families.S_i: if feasible, choose any K with |K|=q-2; y=t_0; x_j=w on K and 0 otherwise; r_i=L
pure_candidate_families.P_i: if feasible, choose any K with |K|=q-2; y=t_1; x_j=w on K and 0 otherwise; r_i=P
pure_candidate_families.R_i_of_nu: every feasible proposal that fails for every type with positive prior probability: k<=q-3, or k=q-2 and y<min{t_theta: Pr(theta|nu)>0}

strategy_profile.candidate_set_B_i: E_i union feasible S_i union feasible P_i union R_i(nu)

proposer_selection.V_star: max over s in B_i(nu) of v_i(s;nu)
proposer_selection.H_star: min expected H payoff h_i(s;nu) among proposals attaining V_star
proposer_selection.conditional_strategy_by_identity: for every recognized proposer i, choose an arbitrary distribution F_i supported on A_i_star(nu)
proposer_selection.identity_rule: F_i need not equal F_j; recognition remains iid uniform over i

closed_form_boundaries.if_o1_below_1_over_m: screening for nu<=nu_SP=beta*(o_1-o_0)/(L-w), pooling for nu>nu_SP
closed_form_boundaries.if_o0_below_1_over_m_below_o1_and_D_posi: screening below nu_SE=beta*(1/m-o_0)/[beta*(1/m-o_0)+D], exclusion above; at equality screening if beta<1 and both if beta=1
closed_form_boundaries.if_o0_equals_1_over_m_below_o1_and_D_pos: at nu=0 screening if beta<1 and screening plus exclusion if beta=1; exclusion for nu>0
closed_form_boundaries.if_o0_below_o1_equals_1_over_m_and_D_pos: screening below nu_SE; at equality screening if beta<1 and screening plus exclusion if beta=1; above it E=P and the minimum of h_E=(1-nu)*o_0+nu*o_1 and h_P=beta/m selects exclusion, pooling, or both
closed_form_boundaries.delay_corner: R_i(nu) is selected iff D=0, o_1>=1/m, and [nu=1 or o_0>=1/m]

belief_system.ballot_on_path: after every proposal with positive probability mass under F_i, Pr(theta=1|s)=nu by Bayes because weak proposer i does not observe theta
belief_system.ballot_zero_probability_proposal: arbitrary kappa_i(s) in [0,1] after every individual zero-probability proposal, including points in the topological support of an atomless F_i
belief_system.published_vote_vector_on_path: nu_prime(s,v)=nu*1{v_H=a_H(s,1)}/[(1-nu)*1{v_H=a_H(s,0)}+nu*1{v_H=a_H(s,1)}] whenever the denominator is positive; type-independent weak-vote factors cancel
belief_system.published_vote_vector_zero_probability: arbitrary eta_i(s,v) in [0,1] after every zero-probability proposal-vote history
belief_system.zero_prior_types: at nu=0 and nu=1, ballot strategies, conditional outcomes, and payoffs remain specified for both theta types; Bayes constrains only histories with positive probability
belief_system.continuation_effect: every nu_prime and eta_i(s,v) maps to N1-EQ-01, whose R2 payoffs are posterior-invariant
belief_system.deviating_proposer_evaluation: every proposal deviation is evaluated under the true pre-proposal prior nu

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: exists for every admissible primitive and nu because E_i is feasible and E>=w; generally strategy-multiple through coalition identities and residual proposal ties; payoff and outcome multiplicity is preserved in the F_i family, especially in the D=0 delay corner and zero-prior-type boundaries
equilibrium_records.selection_status: full family of identity-indexed F_i distributions on the authorized lexicographic argmax A_i_star is preserved; no symmetric or Markov restriction, no belief restriction, and no ad hoc or additional equilibrium selection is added
assumptions_used: fixed unit pie, strict 0<o_0<o_1<1 domain, and package feasibility from Section 2
majority quota, full execution of y, public sealed-ballot vector, and terminal payoffs from Section 4
PBE with pure ballot strategies, weak-only stage-undominated voting, T^Y, and the proposal tie-break from Section 5
exactly-one transport of the frozen N1 continuation under Section 6
no side payments and no exit action
checks_performed: N3-C01 weak vote cutoff and T^Y
N3-C02 complete H IC including nonpivotal y versus y+o_theta
N3-C03 proposer payoff for every feasible proposal and vote profile
N3-C04 P2 exhaustive reduction to E_i, S_i, P_i, and R_i(nu)
N3-C05 P0 full-pie result with endogenous slack exception preserved
N3-C06 P1 strict hedge dominance including off-path proposals
N3-C07 P1a no on-path passage without H with y>0
N3-C09 P2 equality boundaries and proposal tie-break
N3-C10 P2 delay corner and slack multiplicity
N3-C11 proposal beliefs including atomless-support zero-probability points
N3-C12 P7 public H vote and off-path posterior
N3-C15 existence, completeness, multiplicity, and no ad hoc selection
N3-C16 strict o_1<1 domain restriction preserves the N3 correspondence on the remaining domain and leaves the D=0 delay corner admissible

weak_nonproposer_pre_recognition_expecte.type: identity-indexed map; symmetry is not imposed

equilibrium_records.payoff_date: R1 current units; N1 continuation values are multiplied by beta exactly once
